expectations.text: detects-clean-tree: Runs git status and identifies there are no changes to commit
expectations.evidence: result.md shows git status output: 'On branch master / nothing to commit, working tree clean'. Compliance table confirms: 'Correctly detected clean tree: Yes'.

expectations.text: no-empty-commit: Does NOT attempt to run git commit when there are no changes
expectations.evidence: result.md 'Attempted to commit' section: 'No'. Compliance table: 'No empty commit created: Yes (no `git commit` was run)'.

expectations.text: informs-user-clearly: Clearly informs the user that there is nothing to commit — does not error or silently succeed
expectations.evidence: result.md shows the message: 'The working tree is clean. There is nothing to commit. All changes have already been committed or there were no changes to begin with. No action was taken.' Compliance table: 'Clear message shown to user: Yes'.

claims.claim: The skill process ran gracefully without error
claims.evidence: result.md 'Error or graceful' section: 'Graceful — the skill process ran `git status`, detected a clean tree, and stopped without attempting any commit operation.'

eval_feedback.overall: Evals look solid for this scenario. All three assertions are discriminating — they would fail if the skill tried to commit on a clean tree or gave a misleading message. No suggestions.
